This image is a painted grand-strategy map seen straight down, with Băng Tâm Các painted at its centre. Change ONLY the place at the centre, and only as described; keep its layout, every existing building, the terrain, the water, the colours and the golden-hour light from the top left exactly as they are, so the two images can be swapped on the map.

The place grows one development level: Twin frost-rimmed side towers flanking the main pavilion, joined by covered bridges, and a ring of cold wells mist-veiling the lower terraces.

Keep the change inside a circle about 25 % of the image width across the centre. Never: text, labels, writing, symbols on flags, people larger than specks, a frame, a vignette.
